title: Mortgage Loan File Disclosure Worksheet: Nonrecurring Closing Costs on a Corrected Closing Disclosure
content:
**Standard figure.** The standard corrected figure for the nonrecurring closing costs of a Mortgage Loan File is the nonrecurring closing costs shown on the latest Closing Disclosure issued on the file (the one with the highest disclosure sequence), carried forward (0.00 where the file carries no Closing Disclosure), plus the credit report fee charges booked on the file less than 1 whole month before the issue date at their booked amount.

**How the figure is put together.** Each line is added once, in dollars, to the carried-forward figure, and the total is rounded to the cent.

**Terms of the worksheet.**

- *Latest Closing Disclosure* — of the Closing Disclosures in the file's disclosure history, the one with the highest disclosure sequence, whether the initial one or a correction; its nonrecurring closing costs figure is the carried-forward figure.
- *Credit report line* — the booked amounts of the credit report fee charges on the file's fee ledger whose booking date is less than one whole month before the issue date of the corrected Closing Disclosure, added together; a charge is less than one whole month old where the issue date falls before the same day of the month following its booking date.

## Standard figure worked through (hypothetical file)

| Line | Basis | Amount |
|---|---|---|
| Carried-forward figure | nonrecurring closing costs on the Closing Disclosure with the highest sequence | 8432.17 USD |
| Credit report line | one credit report fee charge of 184.80 USD booked 12 days before the issue date | 184.80 USD |
| Standard corrected figure | 8432.17 plus 184.80, rounded to the cent | 8616.97 USD |

## Boundary of the credit report line (hypothetical charge of 92.40 USD booked on 15 May)

| Issue date of the corrected Closing Disclosure | Whole months since the charge | Added |
|---|---|---|
| 14 June | 0 | 92.40 USD |
| 15 June | 1 | nothing |
